title: U.S. government seeks to join Elon Musk in challenge against EU's fine on X
summary: The U.S. formally joined Elon Musk's legal challenge against an EU fine imposed on X, marking a diplomatic move backing Musk in a regulatory dispute with European authorities. The case highlights tensions between U.S. tech companies and EU regulatory oversight. The U.S. government's involvement signals its willingness to challenge European tech regulations.
content: The U.S. formally sought to join Elon Musk’s legal challenge against an EU fine imposed on his social media platform X.

zh.title: 美国政府寻求加入马斯克对欧盟X罚款的挑战
zh.summary: 美国正式加入了埃隆·马斯克对欧盟对X平台罚款的法律挑战，这是一项外交举措，支持马斯克与欧洲当局的监管纠纷。该案突显了美国科技公司与欧盟监管监督之间的紧张关系。美国政府的参与表明其挑战欧洲科技法规的意愿。

title: Surging Treasury yields pose a brand new problem for Kevin Warsh and the Fed
summary: Rising Treasury yields are creating complex challenges for Federal Reserve leadership as markets expect firmer inflation control measures. The situation presents a policy dilemma that extends beyond traditional monetary tools. Higher yields will shape the Fed's approach to interest rates and inflation management.
content: Markets expect the central bank will take a firmer hand on inflation. It's not that easy.

zh.title: 飙升的国债收益率为凯文·沃什和美联储带来新问题
zh.summary: 随着市场预期更严格的通胀控制措施，上升的国债收益率为美联储领导层造成了复杂的挑战。这种局面提出了超越传统货币工具的政策困境。更高的收益率将影响美联储对利率和通胀管理的方式。

title: Oracle Japan shares surge 7% after record fiscal first quarter, bucking selloff of U.S. parent
summary: Oracle Japan's stock surged 7% following record fiscal first-quarter results, significantly outperforming its struggling U.S. parent company. The strong regional performance demonstrates different market dynamics between Japanese and U.S. operations despite broader market pressures. This divergence highlights the varying strength of Oracle's global segments.
content: Oracle Japan shares surged after the company reported record fiscal first-quarter sales and profits.

zh.title: 甲骨文日本公司股价在创纪录的财政第一季度后飙升7%，逆势美国母公司下滑
zh.summary: 甲骨文日本分公司股票在创纪录的财政第一季度业绩后飙升7%，远超其陷入困境的美国母公司。强劲的地区表现展示了日本和美国业务之间的不同市场动力，尽管面临更广泛的市场压力。这种差异突显了甲骨文全球不同部门的不同实力。

title: Stock futures are little changed as Dow heads for fourth straight losing week: Live updates
summary: U.S. stock futures remained relatively flat Thursday while the Dow faced its fourth consecutive losing week amid rising Treasury yields. The Nasdaq and S&P 500 showed minimal movement as investors absorbed higher bond yields. Market sentiment remains cautious as economic data continues to pressure equities.
content: Bond yields continued their climb on Thursday while the Nasdaq and S&P 500 were flat.

zh.title: 股票期货涨跌互现，道琼斯指数面临连续第四周下跌：实时更新
zh.summary: 美国股票期货周四基本持平，道琼斯指数在国债收益率上升的背景下面临连续第四周下跌。纳斯达克和标普500指数表现平稳，投资者消化更高的债券收益率。随着经济数据继续对股票施压，市场情绪保持谨慎。

title: Tesla poised to scale production of heavy-duty Semi trucks with opening of Nevada factory
summary: Tesla is opening its first dedicated heavy-duty truck factory in Sparks, Nevada to expand Semi truck production and enter commercial markets. The facility represents the company's commitment to scaling beyond passenger vehicles into commercial transportation. This expansion could significantly increase Tesla's addressable market in the trucking industry.
content: Elon Musk's automaker is set to open its first heavy-duty truck factory in Sparks, Nevada, as Tesla seeks to expand its reach.

zh.title: 特斯拉在内华达州工厂开业后准备扩大重型半挂卡车产量
zh.summary: 特斯拉在内华达州斯帕克斯开设首家专门的重型卡车工厂，以扩大半挂卡车产量并进入商业市场。该设施代表公司致力于从乘用车扩展到商业运输的决心。这一扩张可能大幅增加特斯拉在卡车行业的市场规模。

title: China's Xi urges U.S. to cooperate on AI
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping urged the United States to cooperate on artificial intelligence during a White House meeting with President Trump. The call for collaboration amid U.S.-China AI competition could establish international norms for AI governance and safety. Cooperation between the superpowers in AI development could reshape global tech policy.
content: U.S. President Donald Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday at the White House.

zh.title: 中国习近平敦促美国在人工智能领域合作
zh.summary: 中国国家主席习近平在白宫与特朗普总统会晤期间敦促美国在人工智能领域进行合作。在中美人工智能竞争的背景下，这一合作呼吁可能建立人工智能治理和安全的国际规范。两个超级大国在人工智能开发中的合作可能改变全球科技政策。

title: Atlanta is getting pandas: China's Xi revives a longtime diplomatic strategy at summit with U.S.
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping promised two giant pandas to Zoo Atlanta, reviving Beijing's traditional 'panda diplomacy' as a soft-power tool. The gesture aims to build goodwill with American institutions and the public during the U.S.-China summit. Giant pandas have remained central to Chinese diplomatic efforts for decades.
content: Chinese President Xi Jinping promised two giant pandas to Zoo Atlanta, reviving Beijing's decades-old charm offensive.

zh.title: 亚特兰大将获得熊猫：中国习近平在美国峰会上复兴长期外交战略
zh.summary: 中国国家主席习近平承诺向亚特兰大动物园赠送两只大熊猫，复兴北京传统的"熊猫外交"作为软实力工具。这一举动旨在美中峰会期间与美国机构和公众建立善意。大熊猫数十年来一直是中国外交努力的中心。

title: Here's who is attending the Trump-Xi state dinner
summary: President Trump hosted a state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping with high-level officials and dignitaries in attendance. The event was part of a broader bilateral summit addressing major issues between the two nations. State dinners serve as important diplomatic occasions for strengthening international relationships.
content: U.S. President Donald Trump hosted a dinner Thursday for Chinese President Xi Jinping.

zh.title: 以下是参加特朗普-习国宴的人员名单
zh.summary: 特朗普总统为中国国家主席习近平举办了国宴，高级官员和政要出席。该活动是解决两国间重大问题的更广泛双边峰会的一部分。国宴是加强国际关系的重要外交场合。

title: Costco makes progress on a key membership metric. Here's our new price target on the stock
summary: Costco's membership renewal rates improved, signaling healthy customer retention despite debates about the metric's broader significance. The company's progress on this indicator has influenced analyst price targets for the stock. Strong membership renewal typically indicates customer satisfaction and future revenue stability.
content: Costco's membership renewal rates moved in the right direction. But the debate isn't totally settled just yet.

zh.title: 好市多在关键会员指标上取得进展。以下是我们对该股的新目标价格
zh.summary: 好市多的会员续期率改善，表明客户保留率健康，尽管关于该指标更广泛意义存在争议。该公司在此指标上的进展影响了分析师对股票的目标价格。强劲的会员续期率通常表明客户满意度和未来收入稳定性。
